turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale, you asked for this meeting. I'd have asked for it anyway. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
I'm not here with an open mind, Hale. I'm here with a zero on my son's essay that nobody called me about. Who decided it, and under which procedure?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
Don't manage me, Hale. I'm still deciding whether to go upstairs. Who decided on the zero, and when?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
Nothing here stays between us, Hale. I'm writing this down and I'll want it in an email tonight. What was the basis for the zero?
